notes.title: Kickstarter for Free Stars: Children of Infinity
notes.content:
Happy Days and Jubilation!

On April 16th, we launched our Kickstarter for Free Stars: Children of Infinity, and within just over 3 hours, it was fully funded!

Our Kickstarter still has several stretch goals to go, from adding voice acting all the way up to completely open-sourcing the entire game and engine. Along the way, there are plenty of digital and physical collectors' goodies for fans of The Ur-Quan Masters to enjoy.

If you haven't already, check out our Kickstarter and help us make the best version of this game we can.

Thank you, and don't forget to *enjoy the sauce*.
